items.headline: Tech Sector Fuels Market Rebound Amid Strong Earnings and Less Hawkish Fed Stance
items.summary: U.S. equities are poised for a strong finish to the week, building on Thursday's robust gains driven by better-than-expected tech earnings from Amazon and a seemingly less hawkish Federal Reserve. While the overall market sentiment is positive, individual stock performance remains highly divergent, particularly among major tech players. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Amazon Surges on Strong Cloud and AI Growth
items.summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares jumped significantly in pre-market trading after reporting stronger-than-expected earnings, driven by robust cloud computing growth and increased AI monetization.

items.headline: Apple Drops on Supply Constraints and China Weakness
items.summary: Apple Inc. stock tumbled in pre-market trading as the company's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue guidance fell short of expectations due to advanced-chip and memory supply constraints, alongside weaker Services and China revenue.

items.headline: Microsoft Leads Tech Rally on Azure Strength
items.summary: Microsoft Corp. saw a substantial surge on Thursday, adding approximately $450 billion to its market capitalization, following robust quarterly results driven by stronger Azure cloud growth and an upbeat forecast related to AI spending.

items.headline: Novo Nordisk Plunges on Disappointing Drug Trial Results
items.summary: Novo Nordisk A/S shares fell sharply after a weight-loss drug trial reportedly yielded disappointing results.

items.headline: U.S. Economy Experiences Slower Growth in Q2 2026
items.summary: The U.S. economy continues to expand, but at a more moderate pace, with GDP growing at an annual rate of 1.5% during the second quarter (April-June) of 2026. This indicates a deceleration from earlier in the year.

items.headline: Civilian Worker Compensation Costs Rise in Q2 2026
items.summary: Compensation costs for civilian workers increased by 0.9%, seasonally adjusted, for the three-month period ending June 2026, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Wages and salaries also rose by 0.9%, with benefit costs increasing by 1.0% in the same period.

items.headline: Technology Sector Leads Market Rebound, Semiconductors Recover
items.summary: The technology sector is spearheading the market's recovery, particularly with semiconductor stocks bouncing back strongly. This resurgence follows concerns earlier in July regarding AI return on investment, which led to a significant sell-off in AI-linked stocks, including the Philadelphia Semiconductor index, which was down over 20% for the month.

items.headline: AbbVie Reports Strong Q2 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: AbbVie ($ABBV) announced strong second-quarter 2026 financial results, with diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $2.03 on a GAAP basis and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.65. The company also unveiled a proposed acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics.

items.headline: LyondellBasell Exceeds Q2 2026 Earnings Expectations
items.summary: LyondellBasell Industries ($LYB) reported net income of $559 million, or $1.71 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026. The company also noted improved market conditions and a divestiture of select European assets to strengthen its portfolio.

items.headline: Oil Prices Ease Amid Resumed Strait of Hormuz Traffic
items.summary: Oil prices eased as traffic resumed through the Strait of Hormuz. This follows ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, with Saudi Arabia proposing a naval coalition to protect trade routes amidst attacks in the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz.
